intro: Tunisia's economy relies on tourism, olive oil, phosphates and factories making goods for Europe.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Tunisia is one of the world's biggest olive oil exporters. Factories make car parts and clothes for Europe, and beach tourism is big.
Many young people struggle to find jobs, and some try to migrate to Europe by boat.

chapters.title: Dates
text: Oases like Tozeur grow prized Deglet Nour dates.
